lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly structured grid of circular high-luminance spots arranged in roughly 10 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with approximately 5-7 spots per column on the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal rows of spots, forming a distinct checkerboard-like lattice pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges run along the upper two-thirds of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with specular highlights on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct transition in patterning is visible on the head and pectoral fin, featuring a higher density of significantly smaller, high-frequency white points compared to the lateral flank.
